components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main visit or follow action on a light field.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:1.2rem; padding:1rem 1.3rem; background:var(--orange, #f45114); color:#fff; font:900 1rem 'Barlow Condensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif; text-transform:uppercase; text-decoration:none; box-shadow:6px 6px 0 var(--espresso, #24130e); transition:transform .2s ease,box-shadow .2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform:translate(3px,3px); box-shadow:3px 3px 0 var(--espresso, #24130e); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--orange, #f45114); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translate(4px,4px); box-shadow:2px 2px 0 var(--espresso, #24130e); }

components.name: Light Button
components.description: A high-contrast action for Waypoint Blue fields.
components.css: .ds-btn-light { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:1.2rem; padding:1rem 1.3rem; background:var(--milk, #f6f2e8); color:var(--blue, #123ca8); font:900 1rem 'Barlow Condensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif; text-transform:uppercase; text-decoration:none; box-shadow:6px 6px 0 var(--espresso, #24130e); transition:transform .2s ease,box-shadow .2s ease; } .ds-btn-light:hover { transform:translate(3px,3px); box-shadow:3px 3px 0 var(--espresso, #24130e); } .ds-btn-light:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--orange, #f45114); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-btn-light:active { transform:translate(4px,4px); box-shadow:2px 2px 0 var(--espresso, #24130e); }

components.name: Navigation CTA
components.description: The compact social destination action in the header.
components.css: .ds-nav-cta { display:inline-flex; gap:.4rem; padding:.7rem 1rem; background:var(--orange, #f45114); color:#fff; font:800 1rem 'Barlow Condensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif; text-transform:uppercase; text-decoration:none; transition:transform .2s ease; } .ds-nav-cta:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-nav-cta:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--orange, #f45114); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-nav-cta:active { transform:translateY(0); }

components.name: Location Chip
components.description: An informational route annotation that locates the shop.
components.html: MONTE VISTA, CAPE TOWN
components.css: .ds-location-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; color:var(--blue, #123ca8); font:800 1rem 'Barlow Condensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-location-chip i { width:.55rem; height:.55rem; margin-right:.5rem; border-radius:50%; background:var(--orange, #f45114); }

components.name: Route Card
components.description: A flat timeline stage for the coffee-and-creative experience.
components.html:
FIRST SIP

GREAT BREWS

Start with a freshly made coffee and let the day slow down.
components.css: .ds-route-card { position:relative; max-width:20rem; padding:1.6rem 1rem 2.4rem 0; border-top:3px solid var(--blue, #123ca8); color:#101010; font-family:'Barlow Condensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif; } .ds-route-card i { position:absolute; top:-11px; left:0; width:15px; height:15px; border:4px solid var(--milk, #f6f2e8); outline:3px solid var(--blue, #123ca8); border-radius:50%; background:var(--orange, #f45114); } .ds-route-card span { display:block; margin-bottom:2rem; color:var(--blue, #123ca8); font-weight:900; } .ds-route-card h3 { margin:0 0 1rem; font:900 2rem/1 'Archivo Black',Impact,sans-serif; } .ds-route-card p { margin:0; font-size:1.15rem; line-height:1.5; }

components.name: Destination Stamp
components.description: A circular marker that identifies A1 Brews as the endpoint of a route.
components.css: .ds-destination-stamp { width:130px; height:130px; display:grid; place-content:center; text-align:center; border-radius:50%; background:var(--orange, #f45114); color:#fff; transform:rotate(-7deg); box-shadow:8px 9px 0 var(--espresso, #24130e); text-transform:uppercase; transition:transform .2s ease; } .ds-destination-stamp:hover { transform:rotate(-3deg) scale(1.03); } .ds-destination-stamp b { font:900 2.6rem/1 'Archivo Black',Impact,sans-serif; } .ds-destination-stamp span { font:900 .8rem 'Barlow Condensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
A1 Brews looks like the brightest landmark on a familiar neighbourhood route. The visual system combines municipal wayfinding, hand-painted shop signage, gallery labels, and layered art materials into a confident identity that makes coffee and creativity feel inseparable.

The world is graphic, warm, and deliberately physical: ultramarine fields behave like destination signs, milk-white surfaces feel like paper, tangerine marks point and invite, and espresso brown adds the weight of coffee and ink. Oversized type, route lines, circular markers, rotated frames, and hard-offset shadows keep the experience lively without weakening its practical purpose of helping visitors find the shop.
keyCharacteristics: High-contrast ultramarine, milk paper, tangerine, and espresso color blocking.
Condensed sign typography paired with oversized, tightly set display lettering.
Circular destination markers, route lines, map geometry, and framed art canvases.
Flat fields with tactile hard-offset shadows instead of soft luxury styling.
Mobile-first stacking that preserves strong type, bold color, and clear visit actions.

rules.name: The Destination Blue Rule
rules.body: Waypoint Blue owns large fields and major headings; it is a navigational anchor, not a minor decorative accent.

rules.name: The Orange Means Energy Rule
rules.body: Use Marker Orange for actions, annotations, nodes, and creative interruptions. Its role is to move the eye or prompt movement.

rules.name: The Sign First Rule
rules.body: Major headings behave like public signs: short, uppercase, tightly tracked, and immediately legible.

rules.name: The Condensed Utility Rule
rules.body: Supporting copy and controls use the condensed family so practical information stays compact beside the oversized display voice.

rules.name: The Route Before Decoration Rule
rules.body: Even when geometry overlaps or rotates, reading order, section entry points, and visit actions stay on a simple vertical route.

rules.name: The Hard Shadow Rule
rules.body: Use offset shadows to imply printed or mounted objects; do not introduce diffuse card shadows or glossy elevation.

rules.name: The Meaningful Circle Rule
rules.body: Circular forms mark a destination, a route point, or the coffee focal object; they are not a general-purpose container shape.

dos: Do give Waypoint Blue, Milk Paper, Marker Orange, and Espresso Brown large, confident fields.
Do use orange markers and route geometry to lead visitors toward an action or destination.
Do keep major headings short enough to read as signage.
Do reserve physical rotation and hard shadows for focal objects, art frames, and actionable placards.
Do preserve a clear single-column reading route when layouts collapse on mobile.
donts: Don't drift into beige café minimalism, soft neutral lifestyle styling, or generic luxury-coffee cues.
Don't use rounded cards as a default container pattern; curves carry destination meaning here.
Don't replace hard offset shadows with blurred, floating dashboard-card elevation.
Don't use orange as passive filler when it can act as a marker, annotation, or call to action.
Don't let collage geometry obscure factual information, navigation, or visit actions.
